findings.issue: Elements of the uint64[] storage array activeTerminatedGroups (four per slot) are printed as raw slot arithmetic on stor[i / 4 + sha3(133)], and def storage calls it 'array of fixed array of uint64'. The same source write (= groupId) is rendered in two different shapes (1638 vs 1948), and the element copy of line 143 is a 250-character line.
findings.rule: For a dynamic array at slot p whose elements are n bytes (k = 32 / n per slot), Mask(8n, 8n*(i % k), stor[i / k + sha3(p)]) >> 8n*(i % k) is p[i], and 'stor[i/k + sha3(p)] = (v << 8n*(i % k)) | stor[..] & ~(mask << 8n*(i % k))' (in either of the two printed shapes) is p[i] = v; type slot p as an array of uintN.

summary: Complete and faithful, with every in-bytecode source loop shown as a while; the main readability problem is the packed uint64[] activeTerminatedGroups, whose element reads and writes are raw slot arithmetic in two different shapes, plus a request id named after a boolean getter.
